mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.branch_name AS branchName, s.address, s.phone, s.email, b.logo_url AS logoUrl, b.logo_storage_key AS logoStorageKey, s.google_maps_location AS googleMapsLocation, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.open_time AS openTime, s.close_time AS closeTime, b.welcome_slogan AS welcomeSlogan, s.status, b.name AS brandName FROM stores s CROSS JOIN brand_settings b WHERE s.id = #{storeId} AND b.id = 1

SELECT s.id, s.branch_name AS branchName, s.address, s.phone, s.email, b.logo_url AS logoUrl, b.logo_storage_key AS logoStorageKey, s.google_maps_location AS googleMapsLocation, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.open_time AS openTime, s.close_time AS closeTime, b.welcome_slogan AS welcomeSlogan, s.status, b.name AS brandName FROM stores s CROSS JOIN brand_settings b WHERE s.id = #{storeId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.id = 1

SELECT s.id, s.branch_name AS branchName, s.address, s.phone, s.email, b.logo_url AS logoUrl, b.logo_storage_key AS logoStorageKey, s.google_maps_location AS googleMapsLocation, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.open_time AS openTime, s.close_time AS closeTime, b.welcome_slogan AS welcomeSlogan, s.status, b.name AS brandName FROM stores s CROSS JOIN brand_settings b WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.id = 1 ORDER BY s.branch_name ASC, s.id ASC
